examples.comment: This section is for examples only and is not read by the tool.

key_explanations.comment: This section explains the purpose of the keys used by the tool.
key_explanations.critical_prefixes: A list of IP prefixes (CIDR notation) considered critical. Announcements involving these prefixes (or more specifics) trigger higher scrutiny and alert severity.
key_explanations.trusted_transit_asns: A list of AS Numbers generally considered reliable transit providers. Currently used for informational context, but could be used in future heuristic checks.
key_explanations.known_bad_actors: A list of AS Numbers identified as sources of malicious BGP activity (e.g., from threat intelligence). Announcements originating from or transiting through these ASNs trigger high-severity alerts.
